wholePhysicalScope: The mapped perimeter controls the nave, tower base, transept and lower chapel alignment. The shrine’s published dimensions cross-check the near-100m length and widths, and the Québec inventory confirms the spires exceed 90m.
lodDetails: Four levels retain the twin spires, basilica nave, crossing and stepped rounded apse.
limitations: Only the standing exterior is represented. Individual bronze-door reliefs and figurative sculptures are suggested in geometry. The glass patterns, side buttress returns and roof details are simplified.
The basilica annexes, plaza sculpture and earlier buildings on the sanctuary property are separate structures.
